Status.Waiting: Waiting for a change on screen…
Status.PausedDetail: The lamp is off. Resume to turn it back on.
Status.NoMonitorDetail: Choose a display on the Display page.
Pause.Tooltip: Turns the lamp off and suspends capture (Ctrl+P)
Home.Subtitle: The lamp mirrors the dominant color of your screen in real time.
Home.HideTooltip: Minimize to the notification area — sync keeps running
Home.IntensityDesc: Multiplies the brightness captured from the screen.
Device.Subtitle: Govee lamp controlled over the local network (LAN API).
Device.IpHint: Address of the lamp on the local network. Press Enter to apply.
Device.ConnectionHint: Checks that the lamp responds on the network.
Device.TestNoReply: No response. Check the IP address and that LAN control is enabled.
Device.ScanPrompt: Run a search to find the Govee lamps on your network.
Device.Scanning: Searching for Govee lamps on the network…
Device.ScanNone: No lamp found. Check that LAN control is enabled in the Govee Home app.
Device.LanHint: |LAN control| must be enabled for the lamp in the Govee Home app (device settings → LAN Control), and the PC must be on the same network.
Display.Subtitle: Choose the display the lamp mirrors and adjust the capture.
Display.None: No display detected. Connect a display, then click Refresh.
Display.FpsDesc: Auto: up to 30 FPS (the rate at which the lamp is updated), only when the image changes. Lower = less GPU/CPU load.
Settings.Subtitle: Language, and how the application behaves at startup, on lock and on close.
Settings.LanguageDesc: Language of the interface. A change takes effect after a restart.
Settings.StartWithWindowsDesc: Launches GoveeScreen when you sign in to Windows.
Settings.StartHiddenDesc: Opens straight in the notification area, without showing the window.
Settings.PauseOnLockDesc: Turns the lamp off when you lock the computer and resumes sync when you unlock it. A manual pause stays in place.
Settings.LampOnLockScreenDesc: As soon as the screen wakes up to ask for the password, the lamp turns back on with its last color; it turns off if the screen goes back to sleep. Sync resumes on unlock.
Settings.CloseToTrayDesc: The ✕ button hides the window instead of quitting: the lamp stays in sync. To quit, use the icon's menu.
Settings.AutoCheckDesc: At startup, then every 12 h, on the project's GitHub Releases. The new version downloads in the background.
Settings.AutoInstallDesc: A downloaded version installs when the application closes (or at the next startup). Otherwise, use “Restart and update”.
Settings.PrereleaseDesc: Also receives beta versions, to try new features early (less stable).
Settings.ShortcutsDesc: Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+4: switch page   ·   Ctrl+P: pause / resume
AppUpdate.Unavailable: Unavailable: this copy wasn't installed with the installer (development version).
AppUpdate.ReadyAuto: Version {0} downloaded: it will be installed when the application closes.
AppUpdate.UpToDate: You have the latest version ({0}) · checked {1}
AppUpdate.SidebarTooltip: GoveeScreen {0} is ready: restart to install it
AppUpdate.NotifyAuto: It will be installed when the application closes, or right away from the icon's menu.
AppUpdate.NotifyManual: Install it from the icon's menu or the settings (Restart and update).
